title: GuardrailDefinition
description: A guardrail the server can evaluate, as listed by `GET /v1/agentHarness/guardrails`. Guardrails are defined in server code. A harness only sets their level.

id.description: Stable id a harness uses to set the guardrail's level.

defaultLevel.description: Level the company default is seeded with.

event.description: Hook event at which the guardrail is evaluated.

available.description: False when the server cannot evaluate the guardrail yet. A harness can still store a level for it, and the level has no effect until the guardrail is available.
